name: git-guard
description: Stops Claude Code from committing, pushing, force pushing or opening PRs unless you grant a counted, expiring permission, and checks commit messages

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the messages and commands (en uses /git-allow and /git-revoke, es uses /permitir and /revocar)

conventionalCommits.title: Require Conventional Commits
conventionalCommits.description: Reject commit messages whose first line is not type(scope): description

englishMessages.title: Require English commit messages
englishMessages.description: Reject commit messages that look like Spanish

blockPullRequests.title: Block pull request creation
blockPullRequests.description: Reject gh pr create so you open pull requests yourself

blockAiAttribution.title: Block AI attribution
blockAiAttribution.description: Reject Co-Authored-By trailers and Generated with Claude signatures in commit commands
